Bill.BriefDescription: Designating manufactured housing communities as nonconforming uses.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to designating manufactured housing communities asnonconforming uses; adding a new section to chapter 35.63 RCW; addinga new section to chapter 35A.63 RCW; and adding a new section tochapter 36.70 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.63 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: After the effective date of this act, a city may designate a newmanufactured housing community as a nonconforming use, but may notorder the removal or phased elimination of an existing manufacturedhousing community because of its status as a nonconforming use.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35A.63 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: After the effective date of this act, a code city may designate amanufactured housing community as a nonconforming use, but may notorder the removal or phased elimination of an existing manufacturedhousing community because of its status as a nonconforming use.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.70 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: After the effective date of this act, a county may designate amanufactured housing community as a nonconforming use, but may notorder the removal or phased elimination of an existing manufacturedhousing community because of its status as a nonconforming use.
